title: ForecastTimeRecord
description: Issue time, valid time, and lead for forecast or analysis products. Does not authorize publishing a nowcast.

issue_time_utc.description: When the product was issued or published (ISO-8601 UTC).

valid_time_utc.description: Instant the product claims to describe (ISO-8601 UTC).

lead_time.description: Explicit lead. Required non-null for forecast when valid_time equals issue_time (zero-lead nowcast lane) or when documenting non-zero lead.

fabricated_clock.description: True if clock components were invented for a date-only source. Must be false or absent for valid records.
